paper_title: O1-Pruner Length-Harmonizing Fine-Tuning for O1-Like Reasoning Pruning
caption: Comparison of inference time-cost on MATH among different models and methods. achieves the shortest inference times (slightly over 1 minute for Marco-o1-7B and 4 minutes for QwQ-32B-Preview), demonstrating its effectiveness in accelerating long-thought model inference for both small and large long thought models.
model_annotation: This figure presents two bar charts comparing the inference times of different models and methods on mathematical problems. The charts display inference time in minutes on the vertical axis, with categories of methods on the horizontal axis. For Marco-o1-7B, the categories are labeled Baseline, Fast-Solving Prompt, SFT, DPO, and O1-Pruner, and for QwQ-32B-Preview, the same categories are used. The value axis ranges from 0 to 2.5 minutes for Marco-o1-7B and 0 to 7 minutes for QwQ-32B-Preview. Each method is represented by a distinct color: Baseline is green, Fast-Solving Prompt is yellow, SFT is gray, DPO is orange, and O1-Pruner is blue. The approximate inference times are as follows: for Marco-o1-7B, Baseline is slightly under 2.2 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt is slightly under 2.1 minutes, SFT is slightly under 1.9 minutes, DPO is slightly under 1.6 minutes, and O1-Pruner is slightly over 1 minute. For QwQ-32B-Preview, Baseline is slightly under 6.5 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt is slightly under 5.5 minutes, SFT is slightly under 5.7 minutes, DPO is slightly under 5.5 minutes, and O1-Pruner is slightly over 4 minutes. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and no bars are visually emphasized beyond color coding.
